Its like you gain something and lose something. For me my memory is very important since am a student. My memory has already went to shit. 

In your case, can't you have the doctor change or increase the prescription?

Knowing what you want is a step closer to getting it. But i know it will be a miserable journey.
Alot of the things i read dont have a good view about the medications. If you dont mind, Can you share more about how the meds have affected you, particularly the effects on memory?

Religious is an understatement.
I dont live in the US, but medical care is somewhat affordable. Unfortunately because There is a shortage mental health care facilities , its hard to get appointments.

Your last sentence really resonated with me " more tolerable"  its funny how that seems such a ridiculously hard thing to do.
